[[File:SuljoWardesFall-CotG.png|thumb|right|250px|Suljo Warde wielding his lightsaber]]
'''Suljo Warde's lightsaber''' was the personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Suljo Warde]]. It housed a [[Dantari crystal/Legends|Dantari crystal]] and produced a brilliant [[Color/Legends|green]] blade. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] featured inlaid precious [[Gemstone/Legends|stone]] from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Warde used his lightsaber to preemptively attack and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during attempted [[Battle of Jorra|cease-fire negotiations]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. The Jedi Knight subsequently mortally wounded with his weapon his two fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Jiv Durael]] and [[Kaddo Moll]], during a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] that erupted when the pair attempted to arrest him.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref>

{{RPG|''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''}}
Two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, Warde used his lightsaber to attack a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals who had retraced Warde's steps to [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]].<ref name="Chronicles" />
